exposure: single-dose adjunctive azithromycin prophylaxis during emergency cesarean section
standard cephalosporin prophylaxis alone during emergency cesarean section
cohort: 520 pregnant women at >=28 weeks gestation undergoing emergency cesarean section at B.M. Patil Medical College and Research Centre, Vijayapura.
finding: Adding single-dose adjunctive azithromycin prophylaxis before an emergency cesarean section significantly reduced postoperative complication rates and NICU admissions compared to standard prophylaxis alone.
